environment.suiteScope: Exact selected ordinary Chromium identities only; no complete Broad E2E run.

rawCaptureProvenance.handling: Original Playwright JSON was captured in mode-0600 private temporary files and hashed before normalization. Raw files were excluded from Git because they contain absolute paths and environment data; normalized artifacts retain their hashes but cannot independently replay the original bytes.

route.observed: The route test's URL assertion reached /simulator/free/architecture-rise. At the failed five-second heading assertion, the snapshot showed the Loading simulator workspace fallback: routing completed but the workspace had not mounted.

sceneMount.observed: The failed Architecture Rise canvas check showed the simulator shell and 3D Scene heading; the scene-canvas container resolved but had zero descendant canvases at five seconds.

renderer.observed: The controlled WebGL recovery test saw an empty renderer-family attribute at four workers; it passed alone and in the one/two-worker matrix. Its test seam deliberately injects a material-module failure.

groundGlassRtt.observed: The one-worker lifecycle cases passed with valid contentful Ground Glass and checked current RTT identity, previous-node detachment, and fresh scene generation on A-to-B-to-A return.

spa.observed: Scene-focus A-to-B passed at one and four workers and timed out at two; the separate A-to-B-to-A lifecycle check passed with old scene/RTT nodes detached.

cameraFocus.observed: The physical camera-anchor test passed at workers 1/2/4. Continuous viewpoint focus passed at one worker and failed at two/four; the two-worker SPA focus predicate failed.

viewportGeometry.observed: Expanded viewport ratio 1.1988203216292916 against 1.25 reproduced at one and two workers. Four workers failed earlier at canvas count.

diagnosticLimits: The trace subset is instrumented and excluded from clean outcome totals.
No renderer status/generation telemetry was added.
No GPU readback or native GPU capture was performed.

hypotheses.evidence: Correct URL; workspace loading fallback at failing heading assertion.
Canvas was absent inside a mounted scene container; renderer status/context acquisition were not captured.
Canvas target passed with three lightweight peers and failed with three renderer-heavy peers; both runs measured four concurrent tests.
A-to-B-to-A regression verified detached old nodes and fresh current scene generation.
Physical anchor passed at workers 1/2/4; continuous focus remained worker-sensitive.

diagnosis.schedulingAssociation: One matched four-test probe associated renderer-heavy peers with a missing canvas and two peer timeouts; this does not isolate a causal mechanism.
rejectedClaims: Missing canvas proves WebGL context creation failed.
Missing heading is a renderer failure.
A passing A-to-B-to-A test proves all transitions stable.
Viewport ratio mismatch is caused by renderer readiness.
The controlled recovery test exercises native WebGPU.
